outcome: The cash forecast page shows the live forecast, its group disclosure and its delivery state, read only
acceptance_criteria: Opening `/work/4301` against the mock (Next 4990, mock 4991) shows the forecast header (entity, currency, basis, "As of {date}"), six month rows, and the delivery line "Receipt 9" — verify: open the page; `frontend/e2e/cash-forecast-live.spec.ts` asserts the rows and the receipt text.

Against live Django (8030) for a real forecast work id the page shows the same entity, currency, as_of, periods, jobs and matches as `GET /api/v1/work/{id}/forecast` — verify: compare the page with the `curl` JSON and `python3 delivery/connect/oa.py live GET /api/v1/work/{work_id}/forecast 4`.

A period with an unknown amount (4301 January closing) reads "Unknown" in the table and in the page text; no 0, no carried-forward opening, and no sum is computed — verify: e2e on 4301; unit test on the period mapper with a missing, null and `"0.00"` amount, which must render as Unknown, Unknown and the zero amount respectively.

`result: null` (4303) shows the stage, finding and "No forecast figures yet." with no table, no delivery section and no matched-actuals section other than "No actuals matched yet." — verify: e2e and mapper unit test.

`/work/4307` and a live id the account cannot see both show exactly "This record is unavailable."; 401 shows the sign-in link with `next`; 403 `csrf_failed` is not shown as no-access; 409 and 422 show their own wording; a failed forecast read keeps the work item header on screen — verify: mock scenarios plus unit tests on the error mapping.

The uncertain state (4305) shows the job status raw, "Outcome not known" when `observation.outcome` is `unknown`, "Restart allowed under rule 12", and the text "Nothing has been resent from this page."; no Retry, Cancel, Record what happened or Resend button exists — verify: e2e on 4305 asserts the texts and the absence of those four buttons.
A job with `receipt_ids: []` reads "No receipt yet" and never a tick or "Received" — verify: unit test and e2e on 4305.

`observation.has_proof` true (4306) shows a "Proof on file" link whose href is `/api/v1/work/{id}/forecast/observations/{observation.id}`; false shows "No proof on file" and no link; the page does not request that URL while rendering — verify: e2e asserts the href and that the network log has no request to it until clicked.

Group disclosure (4304) shows only `selected_rows`, `selected_fields`, `selected_metadata` and recipients as sent; the poisoned variant (a payroll key in `selected_rows`, an item with `staff_name` and `pay`) shows the key text only and draws no staff name and no pay figure anywhere on the page, and no request is made to any payroll route — verify: e2e on the poisoned fixture asserts the DOM text contains neither the staff name nor the pay figure and the request log has no `payroll` URL; unit test on the disclosure mapper drops unknown object fields other than a whitelist (`key`, `label`, `kind`, `amount`, `expected_on`, `original_due`, `commitment`, `residual`, `matched`).

A payroll-related assumption appears on a group view only when it is listed in `disclosure.selected_rows` or `selected_fields` of the read; with a null `disclosure` on `audience: 'group'` none appears — verify: unit tests on both inputs.

`disclosure.row_keys`, `oracle_choices` and `decision_choices` are drawn as read-only text with no checkbox, select or input in the disclosure section — verify: e2e asserts zero `input`, `select` and `[role=checkbox]` elements inside the disclosure section.

Selecting month 2026-11 loads `GET /work/{id}/forecast/actuals/2026-11` once and shows rows, actuals (direction In or Out, Verified or Not verified) and history (Reversed marked); an actual with a null amount reads "Unknown" — verify: e2e and network panel; unit test on the actuals mapper.

When `more_actuals`, `more_history` or `more_notes` is true the section says "Showing the first rows only. The rest isn't available here." and no "Show more" control exists; when all are false the sentence is absent — verify: e2e on both fixtures.
A month with no rows shows "No actuals recorded for {month}."; a 404 on a month shows "This record is unavailable." and leaves the forecast sections on screen — verify: mock scenarios and e2e.

The page sends no write: no `POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH` or `DELETE` is made on any forecast state, and none of Approve, Return, Reject, Withdraw, Post, Record, Match, Leave unmatched, Save, Retry, Cancel appears as a button — verify: e2e records the request methods and the button names on 4301 to 4306; `grep -n "liveApi.POST\|\.POST(" frontend/src/features/forecast` returns nothing.
No "reviewer not set" text and no shortened money ("M" suffix) is drawn at 1440 or 390 — verify: e2e text search on 4302 at both widths.
A null `expected_revision` or `case_revision` is carried as null and not rendered as 0 — verify: unit test on the adapter's context mapping.

The adapter registers under the live panel key and `adapterFor(key)` returns it; a panel key with no adapter still does not break the page — verify: `forecastAdapter.test.ts` and the F-85 unknown-key test stays green.
The generated live types for the three reads match contract 1.24.0 and `api-live-schema-drift.test.ts` passes — verify: `npm test`; `delivery/checks.sh`.

At 1440 and 390 the page matches the SCR-56 boards for the parts that remain (investigating, review without decide controls, group rows and group review without edit controls, uncertain without recovery controls, verified, actuals without record controls); hidden parts leave no empty heading or gap and the table scrolls only inside its region — verify: screenshots at both widths against the SCR-56 artboards; axe WCAG 2.2 AA has no violations on 4301 to 4305.
The v7 forecast pages `W-4001..W-4013` and `e2e/cash-forecast.spec.ts` still pass unchanged while lane C's adapter route is not used for them — verify: run that spec.

New tests: unit tests for the section mapper (periods, items, findings, matches, disclosure, delivery), the actuals mapper, and the error mapping; one e2e file for 4301 to 4307 — verify: the files exist and run in `npm test` and `npm run e2e`.

risk.rationale: Medium. It is read-only and sends nothing, but it shows forecast money and group-disclosure content that could carry payroll-related assumptions (E-26), so the security surface applies. The sections of the forecast response are loosely typed, so the mapping must be tested against the live contract in `contracts/psl-factory.openapi.json`. Read-only screens can merge under D-180/D-184. If any payroll-related row can appear in the group view, route the merge to the design engineer's batch.

completion.reason: Project, readiness, implementation and review evidence has not been supplied.
